1200x628.notes: Responsive display landscape image asset, 1.91:1. Recommended 1200x628 (600x314 minimum). Google composes the headline and CTA itself around this image, so keep baked-in copy short -- it may appear alongside Google's own.

1200x1200.notes: Responsive display square image asset, 1:1. Recommended 1200x1200 (300x300 minimum). Google pairs it with the landscape asset; supplying both is what lets a responsive ad serve across the whole network.

1200x1500.notes: Responsive display portrait image asset, 4:5. Recommended 1200x1500 (320x400 minimum). Optional where the landscape and square are not: Google serves without it, and supplying it buys the taller placements the other two cannot fill.
